horoscope: The Moon moves into your sign for a couple of days, dear Aries, and your emotions are taking the lead. Today, you may have additional obligations to attend to with the Moon and Saturn aligning. You’re a self-starter, and you can find good outlets for self-expression, especially through special interests or networking. For the most part today, you are likely to feel a heartening sense of purpose. Today's energies are good for nurturing a personal interest, explaining yourself, and putting a positive message out there. Still, it can be challenging to make a satisfying choice as you could be feeling you'll lose out no matter what you choose.

It's not the best idea to fall back on relating patterns that haven't served you well in the past today, dear Taurus. Repeating these old patterns can prompt others to focus on the negative parts of your relationship's history. It would serve you well to keep your mind open to improved ways of connecting and interacting. Use any conflicts that arise now as fuel to motivate yourself to improve. The Moon moves into the sign behind yours, where it will stay for a couple of days. You need some extra time to yourself or simply away from the grind and regular routine. Aim to clear out extra mental clutter for the best results now. Focusing on others can be rewarding, particularly if you are helping out.

While you can be finding special joy in a relationship, clarity is unlikely regarding a work or health problem today, dear Gemini, primarily because you're too close to the situation or worrying unnecessarily. Even with old issues resurfacing, a new talk about these matters is not the best idea, as it may very well run in circles. Look for patterns that are no longer serving your best interests. You may feel a strong need to be productive today, though your focus is less on practical pursuits and more on happiness goals. The Moon moves into your social sector for a visit of over two days, and the key to emotional fulfillment right now may be focusing on your treasured wishes and dreams. You may find common goals, interests, and philosophies more apparent, or appreciate them more.

Today's not ideal for getting advice or listening to your own worries regarding a relationship, dear Cancer. You may be at a loss when it comes to understanding the motivations behind someone's actions, words, or disinterest. It may be better to enjoy a sense of autonomy for the moment, and then circle back to issues when people are more self-aware. Fortunately, in most areas, you can feel more directed and purposeful than usual today. Your responsibilities and performance are high on your list of interests right now. You can feel a strong need to manage a situation or put more energy into your practical priorities.

It can be difficult to know whether to stick with the tried and true or to branch out and do something all-new at times today, dear Leo. However, the Moon heads into your sector of spirit, the higher mind, and sharing ideas, where it will visit for over two days, stirring a craving for engaging experiences and a break from the routine or a change of scenery. You might enjoy some serious learning, studying, sharing, or thinking. You may feel ambitious about improving your situation. Consider ways to release yourself from intense emotions, if you don't already gravitate towards them naturally today.

You can feel a little drained or burdened in spots today, dear Virgo, but you may only need a bit of space to sort things out. The Moon heads into your intimacy sector early today for a visit of over two days. You’re inclined to take things a little more seriously than usual with this transit, and that's especially true today with the Moon’s alignment with Saturn. You may be determined to get to the bottom of a problem by researching or investigating, or by getting into an absorbing project or activity. You might enjoy piecing things together and paying attention to various details. You have greater self-understanding now, along with a sense of inner strength and resolve.

You can experience a strong drive to connect and learn something useful today, dear Libra. You can experience some indecision or temporary doubt about a partner or a business endeavor. As much as you would like to make a decision and move on, try not to rush, especially if it involves critical financial matters or a partnership. The Moon heads into your opposite sign for a visit of over two days, and you can be quite focused on your relationships today. It’s also a good day to apply yourself, especially to pursuits that fulfill you socially and emotionally. The secret to happiness today seems to be balance and patience.

There can be some uncertainties or doubts setting in today, dear Scorpio, but nothing that can't be sorted through. In fact, you may need a bit of structure and order to do so, and you can benefit from it now. Decisions shouldn't be made lightly, but if you can't fix something, try not to worry too much about it and save it for a time when you're more patient and have more time to get to its core. Fortunately, you’re in the right frame of mind for attention to detail, and you can feel quite compelled to take care of business. You may want to get on top of your routine or daily affairs, and you can feel more fulfilled if you handle problem areas.

Keep in mind that small disruptions or doubts can ultimately lead you to bigger and better things, dear Sagittarius. There's some tendency to take things a little more seriously, and while it can initially feel deflating, you may very well lean into it and appreciate a little more order. The Moon meets responsible Saturn today, and while you may face a block or delay that keeps you from doing the things you enjoy, you’re likely drawn to spending time on productive things, finding it soothing and satisfying. You might learn something important about a love interest, or about your own feelings.

Focusing on things that genuinely make you feel grounded and secure can be in order today, dear Capricorn. With the Moon's move into your solar fourth house, you're inclined to pay more attention to personal matters, your support system, home, or family. You're also likely to focus on the practical side of your domestic world or personal life. In fact, as you straighten out your home environment, you may gain greater inner clarity. Dialing things back a little makes sense now, but you still want to be productive. Centering yourself or pacing yourself will get you back on track.

While yesterday's energies seem to rush you, dear Aquarius, today seems to demand more seriousness and patience. A bit of self-discipline can go a long way, as events of the day might awaken a need to get going on something for which you’ve been procrastinating. Still, your curiosity is engaged. The Moon moves into your solar sector of communication early today, where it will visit for over two days. Today, you may have an important conversation or obligations to meet. With moderation, it can be an excellent time for pouring energy into constructive projects. It may also be a time to reconnect with someone you've lost touch with.

Today's energies tend to slow you down, dear Pisces. While there can be some minor disappointments or worries to manage, you might quickly adjust to the pace and use it to your benefit. Still, it may be better to take in and observe than to jump into action until you sort things out. You can have a strong urge to get your practical affairs in order today. The Moon moves into your sector of resources and security early today, where it will visit for over two days, and you tend to take stock of what you have and what you might need. You’re thinking ahead rather than concerning yourself with immediate gratification. You might gravitate to activities that ground you. Certainly, you can approach routine or comforting matters in different or unusual ways, with a new or improved approach.
